stem.text: Which statement about radioactive decay is correct?

B.text: The $\alpha$-particles emitted from a radioactive sample have a continuous range of kinetic energies.

C.text: The $\beta^{-}$ particles emitted from a radioactive sample have a continuous range of kinetic energies.

D.text: The proton number of a nucleus decreases by four when it undergoes $\alpha$-decay.
